component.name: Reddart
component.summary: Zero-lag 4K/60fps professional video editor powered by Rust and wgpu

description.p: Reddart is a professional-grade, zero-lag desktop video editor designed for high-throughput real-time editing at 4K 60fps. Powered by a 100% Rust engine with GPU shader pipelines, Reddart delivers deterministic timelines, predictive frame prefetching, on-device Whisper speech-to-text, neural audio denoising, AI portrait matting, and surround audio mixing.

ul.li: Zero-lag timeline scrubbing and trimming with real-time multi-track compositing
Hardware-accelerated rendering and export via wgpu (Vulkan / Direct3D 12 / Metal)
On-device Whisper AI speech-to-text and automatic subtitle generation
Neural audio denoising with STFT Wiener filtering and harmonic hum suppression
AI portrait matting with linear-time Guided Image Filtering and green spill removal
5.1 and 7.1 surround sound mixing with ITU-R BS.775 spatial audio panning
Deterministic Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) for atomic crash recovery and zero data loss
Predictive lookahead prefetching with bounded frame caching
On-device Whisper speech-to-text and subtitle track generation
Compound clips and nested sequence timelines
Neural audio denoising and video AI matting
Cross-platform standalone packaging for Linux, macOS, and Windows
